title: INSTALLATION OF ROTOR SENSOR / REPLACEMENT OF REAR OIL SEAL

content.description: Illustration showing installation of rotor sensor on output shaft with key in groove

content.text: 1. INSTALL ROTOR SENSOR ON OUTPUT SHAFT

items: (a) Make sure that the key is installed in the groove.
(b) Install the rotor sensor on the shaft.

content.description: Illustration showing installation of speedometer drive gear with lock ball and snap ring pliers

items: (a) Slide the lock ball and the speedometer gear on the shaft.
(b) Using snap ring pliers, install the outer snap ring.

content.text: 1. RAISE VEHICLE, AND POSITION PAN TO CATCH ANY FLUID THAT MAY DRIP

content.description: Illustration showing removal of rear dust seal and oil seal using SST tool

content.text: 3. REMOVE REAR DUST SEAL AND OIL SEAL
CAUTION: Clean the rear extension housing before removing the seal.
Using SST, remove the two seals.

content.description: Illustration showing installation of new oil seal and dust seal using SST tool

content.text: 4. INSTALL NEW OIL SEAL AND DUST SEAL
Using SST, drive in the oil seal as far as it will go. Drive in the dust seal flush with the housing.
6. LOWER VEHICLE AND CHECK FLUID LEVEL (See page MA-13)
Start the engine, shift the selector into each gear, then check the fluid level with the transmission in "P" range. Add fluid as necessary.
